# Eval Parsed Formula Node

![Eval Parsed Formula Node function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/math/formula-evaluation/08_Eval%20Parsed%20Formula%20Node%20VI.svg)

[Mathematics functions](../../mathematics/index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Evaluates a versioned FROG prepared assignment program, distinct from Prepared Formula String. Its input names and output order are sealed at preparation; only Input Values change. Create it using Prepare Formula Node on the input. Fixed exact f64/Array signatures, without scalar lifting, broadcasting or implicit numeric conversion. Explicit FROG profile frog.studio.formula.evaluation@1 is distinct from the historical ODE dialect. Prepared payloads are validated versioned AST, never source to re-parse at evaluation or native pointers. NI connector documentation does not establish prepared binary compatibility or measured algorithm parity. Error in/out use the standard Error Cluster; incoming active errors are preserved.
